UnitStatement: Execution Scripts provide standalone validation and integrity tooling for the execution workspace.
references_hash_tool.py (DEL-08-01) computes and verifies ContentHash fields for out-of-folder references in _REFERENCES.md.
references_hash_tool.py exposes compute, verify, and recompute commands, each taking a deliverable or _REFERENCES.md path.
references_hash_tool.py compute and recompute return exit code 0 on completion (file may or may not have changed).
references_hash_tool.py compute and recompute return exit code 2 on invalid path or runtime error.
references_hash_tool.py verify returns exit code 0 when verification passes or a bypass is recorded with --allow-bypass.
references_hash_tool.py verify returns exit code 1 when verification fails.
references_hash_tool.py verify returns exit code 2 on invalid path, missing bypass metadata, or runtime error.
Bypass recording for references_hash_tool.py verify must be used only with explicit human approval.
A bypass is recorded by running references_hash_tool.py verify with --allow-bypass --actor and --reason flags.
By default, bypass records append to a deliverable-local HASH_VERIFICATION_BYPASS.jsonl file.
validate_dependencies.py (DEL-08-02) lints Dependencies.csv files against the v3.1 schema from docs/SPEC.md Section 6.
validate_dependencies.py accepts a path to a single Dependencies.csv file as input.
validate_dependencies.py supports a --scan mode to recursively scan a directory such as execution/.
validate_dependencies.py returns exit code 0 when all files pass (warnings allowed).
validate_dependencies.py returns exit code 1 on one or more schema validation failures.
validate_dependencies.py returns exit code 2 on unreadable or missing inputs or tool failure.
validate_dependencies.py supports --format json for machine-readable CI consumption.
A workspace-wide dependency schema lint runs validate_dependencies.py --scan execution/ --format json.
A pre-run reference integrity check runs references_hash_tool.py verify against a target deliverable with --format json.
